Job Title: Software  Development Intern  (ASP.NET Core “C#”)
Company: LOLC (Cambodia) Plc.

Apply Now
Workplace Circumstances
Environment:
Office
Languages:
English, Khmer
Location:
Phnom Penh
Position Circumstances
Career Category:
Computer - General, Computer - Programming, Internship
Schedule:  Full-time
Salary:
Negotiable
Position Summary 		   Location: Head Office
Duties & Responsibilities:
• Learn   and  try   to  understand in-house system development, configuration,   and  functionality.
• Attend   the  training needed   or  assigned by managements   and  help   to  support end-user.
• Test   new  system release (participating   in  quality control team).
• Participant   with  software   development  team   to  produce development/reports   to  appropriate management personnel.
• Join   development  and in-house system   support  with team.
• Knowledge   of  .net applications development.
• System back-up/maintenance;   and  other tasks assigned by management.
Expected Profile of Candidates
Qualifications:
• Undergraduate Degree   in  year 3-student   in  Information Technology/Computer Science  as   a  minimum
Skills & Knowledge:
General & Technical Skills
• Have knowledge   of  ASP.NET Core (C#)   or  Flutter, Oracle database   is  an advantage.
• Preferably   with  students   who  willing   to  learn   and  work.
Soft Skills
• Have strong teamwork, good communication, motivating, problem solving.
• Ability   to  work under pressure.
